blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Long instructional videos are increasingly used in medical education, industrial training, and procedural knowledge transfer, yet their evidence is often incomplete or unreliable: subtitles may be missing, ASR noisy, OCR sparse, and decisive actions briefly shown without narration. Existing VideoQA systems typically return labels or free-form text, making answer support difficult to inspect. We study Long Video Moment Question Answering (LVMQA), where a system returns timestamped answer-supporting evidence. We propose EP-LVMQA, an evidence-preserving coarse-to-fine framework comprising an Uncertainty-Aware Multimodal Evidence Timeline, a Coarse Evidence Planner, and an Evidence-Conditioned Fine Localizer. An evidence card transfers planner scores, matched cues, source-confidence proxies, modality-specific evidence, neighboring context, and a temporal prior between the latter two modules. On MedVidQA, EP-LVMQA achieves 26.1 R1@0.5 and 31.8 mIoU, improving the strongest non-ours results by 6.3 and 5.1 points. It raises Suff.@2 and Ver.@2 to 25.4 and 22.6, gains of 9.5 and 8.8 points. Under matched low-quality perturbations, average relative degradation is reduced from the strongest non-ours value of 14.6% to 11.1%. On Ego4D-NLQ and QVHighlights, EP-LVMQA remains broadly comparable to established task-specific localization methods.
blocks.zh: 在医学教育、工业培训和程序知识转让中越来越多地使用长长的教学录像,但其证据往往不完整或不可靠:字幕可能缺失、ASR吵闹、OCR稀疏,以及没有叙述的决定性行动。 现有视频 QA系统一般会返回标签或自由格式文本,使得回答支持难以检查. 我们研究了长视频瞬间问题回答(LVMQA),一个系统在其中返回有时间标记的回答支持证据. 我们提议采用EP-LVMQA,这是一个证据保全粗细框架,包括一个不确定的、有意识的多式联运证据时间表、一个粗细的证据规划员和一个有证据的精细本地化器。 一个证据卡传输计划员的分数,匹配的提示,源自信的代理,特定模式的证据,相邻上下文,以及后两个模块之间的时间前缀. 在MedVidQA上,EP-LVMQA实现26.1 R1@0.5和31.8 mIoU,使最强的非我们成绩提高了6.3和5.1分. 它将Suff.@2和Ver.@2提高到25.4和22.6,收益9.5和8.8分. 在相应的低质量扰动下,平均相对降解率从14.6%的最强非我们的值降至11.1%。 在Ego4D-NLQ和QVHighlights上,EP-LVMQA仍然大致可以与既定的任务特定本地化方法相比.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Video question answering (VideoQA) increasingly couples answer prediction with temporal grounding ( Jang et al. 2017 ; Lei et al. 2018 ; Xiao et al. 2024 ; Di and Xie 2024 ) . Natural-language video localization has likewise progressed from proposal-based matching to set prediction and unified grounding ( Gao et al. 2017 ; Lei et al. 2021 ; Moon et al. 2023b ; Lin et al. 2023 ) . Yet most systems either generate an answer or retrieve a query-matching interval; they do not preserve the multimodal provenance needed to inspect whether the interval actually supports the answer.
blocks.zh: 视频问题回答(VideoQA) 夫妇越来越多地用时间定位来回答预测(Jang等2017;Lei等. 2018; 肖等. 2024; 迪和谢 2024 (中文(简体) ). 自然语言视频本地化也从基于提案的匹配发展到设定预测和统一地基(Gao等人)。 2017; Lei等编. 2021; 穆恩等编. 2023b; Lin等2023 (中文(简体) ). 然而,大多数系统要么生成一个答案,要么检索一个查询匹配间隔;它们并不保留检查间隔是否实际支持答案所需的多式出处。

blocks.en: This gap matters in long instructional videos, where answer evidence spans unreliable sources. MedVidQA pairs medical questions with timestamped visual answers ( Gupta et al. 2023 ) , but real recordings may contain noisy ASR, sparse OCR, and plausible yet visually unsupported captions. Answer-seeking questions may also express needs that do not literally name the target action. Long-video methods reduce search cost through window selection and coarse-to-fine alignment ( Hou et al. 2023b ; Pan et al. 2023 ; Barrios et al. 2023 ; Mu et al. 2024 ) . Figure 1 (a) abstracts the text-driven variant: ASR or OCR guides coarse retrieval, but only candidate clips, features, or relevance scores reach the fine localizer. This handoff discards source identity, confidence, availability masks, matched cues, neighboring context, and the temporal prior.
blocks.zh: 这个空白在长长的教学视频中很重要,其中答案证据横跨不可靠的来源. 医疗维度 QA将医疗问题与时间标记的视觉答案(Gupta等人,2023年)相配,但真实的录音可能包含吵闹的ASR,稀疏的OCR,以及可信但视觉上没有支持的字幕. 寻找答案的问题也可能表达不实称目标动作的需求. 长视频方法通过窗口选择和粗细对接来降低搜索成本(Hou等. 2023b; Pan et al. 2023; 巴里奥斯等. 2023; Mu等2024 (中文(简体) ). 图1 (a)摘要 文本驱动的变体: ASR或OCR引导粗重取回,但只有候选剪辑,特征,或关联分数到达精细的本地化器. 这种交接方式会丢弃源身份,自信,可用口罩,相匹配的提示,相邻上下文,以及时间前.

blocks.en: The discarded information affects localization quality, not merely the explanation produced afterward. A generated caption can make a broadly related window rank highly even when a brief visual action in a neighboring window provides the decisive evidence. A clip-conditioned localizer cannot distinguish mutually supporting sources from a single unreliable cue or recover the planner’s temporal rationale. The retrieval-to-localization interface therefore determines whether the model can reject misleading evidence, refine both boundaries, and expose why the returned moment supports the answer.
blocks.zh: 被丢弃的信息影响本地化的质量,而不仅仅是事后作出的解释. 生成的字幕可以让一个广义相通的窗口处于高位,即使一个相邻窗口中的短暂视觉动作提供了决定性的证据. 一个有剪接条件的本地化器无法将相互支持的来源与单一不可靠的提示区分开来,也无法恢复规划者的时间理由。 因此,从检索到本地化的接口决定了模型是否能够拒绝误导性的证据,细化两个边界,并揭露返回的瞬间支持答案的原因.

blocks.en: Figure 1: (a) Text-driven methods pass ASR/OCR-retrieved clips or scores to a clip-conditioned localizer, yielding a loose interval without provenance. (b) EP-LVMQA transfers multimodal evidence and source-aware metadata in an evidence card, enabling routed, prior-guided refinement and an inspectable primary evidence moment.
blocks.zh: 图1: (a)由文本驱动的方法将ASR/OCR检索到的片段或分数传递到有片段条件的本地化器上,产生一个松散的间隔而无出处. (b) EP-LVMQA在证据卡中转移多式证据和源知识元数据,从而能够进行路由、事先指导的改进和检查原始证据。

blocks.en: We therefore study Long Video Moment Question Answering (LVMQA): given a long video and an answer-seeking question, return a timestamped primary evidence moment rather than unconstrained text. Figure 1 contrasts the two interfaces. Text-driven methods pass candidate clips and relevance scores to a clip-conditioned localizer, often yielding a loose interval without an inspectable trace. EP-LVMQA instead transfers a multimodal evidence card with source-specific payloads and retrieval metadata, enabling routing and prior-guided refinement. The target is a finely bounded primary evidence moment accompanied by an evidence trace.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们研究长视频瞬间问答(LVMQA):由于一段长视频和一个寻回问题,返回一个时间标出的主要证据瞬间,而不是不受限制的文本. 图1对比了两个接口. 由文本驱动的方法将候选剪辑和关联性分数传递给一个有剪辑条件的本地化器,往往产生松散的间隔而无可检查的痕迹. EP-LVMQA转而转让带有特定源的有效载荷和检索元数据的多式证据卡,从而能够进行路由和事先指导的改进。 目标是一个精确的原始证据时刻,并附有证据追踪。

blocks.en: EP-LVMQA operationalizes this design with an Uncertainty-Aware Multimodal Evidence Timeline, a Coarse Evidence Planner, and an Evidence-Conditioned Fine Localizer. The card transfers the planner score, modality payloads, confidence proxies, availability masks, matched cues, neighboring context, and a temporal prior. Its retained fields also support the returned evidence trace.
blocks.zh: EP-LVMQA用一个不确定的、实用的多式证据时间线、一个粗糙的证据规划员和一个有证据条件的精细本地化器实施这一设计。 牌会传送计划者得分,方式有效载荷,信心代用符,可用口罩,相匹配提示,相邻上下文,以及时间前传. 其保留地也支持了归还的证据追踪。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: (1) we formulate low-quality instructional VideoQA as localization of inspectable answer evidence; (2) we introduce an Evidence-Preserving Candidate Interface with source-aware routing and prior-guided refinement; and (3) on MedVidQA, controlled perturbations, and two cross-benchmark checks, we show gains in localization, robustness, and human-audited evidence quality while identifying planner misses and imperfect faithfulness as limitations.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三: (1)我们制作了低质量的教学录像 作为可检查的回答证据的本地化;(2) 我们引入了一个证据-保留候选人界面,其源头识别路径和事先指导的改进;(3) 关于MedVidQA, 受控扰动和两个跨基准检查,我们显示在本地化、稳健性以及经人审计的证据质量方面有所进展,同时将规划者缺失和不完善的忠诚度确定为局限性。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Grounded VideoQA. VideoQA links answers to spatio-temporal evidence ( Jang et al. 2017 ; Lei et al. 2018 ; Xiao et al. 2024 ; Di and Xie 2024 ) . Instructional grounding spans TACoS and HowTo100M ( Regneri et al. 2013 ; Miech et al. 2019 ) . EP-LVMQA instead outputs timestamped evidence with provenance.
blocks.zh: 有底盘的视频 QA. 视频 QA链接到spatio-时态证据的答案(Jang等2017;Lei等. 2018; 肖等. 2024; 迪和谢 2024 (中文(简体) ). 教学地平面跨度为TACoS和HowTO100M(Regneri等)。 2013; Miech等2019 (中文(简体) ). EP-LVMQA转而输出带有出处的有时间标记的证据。

blocks.en: Temporal grounding. Methods include proposal/span prediction ( Gao et al. 2017 ; Hendricks et al. 2017 ; Ghosh et al. 2019 ; Zhang et al. 2020a ) , 2D maps ( Zhang et al. 2020b ) , DETR localization ( Lei et al. 2021 ; Moon et al. 2023a ; Moon et al. 2023b ) , joint retrieval/highlights ( Liu et al. 2022 ; Lin et al. 2023 ) , and long-video grounding ( Hou et al. 2023b ; Pan et al. 2023 ; Mu et al. 2024 ; Yuan et al. 2025 ) . Movie grounding and Video-LLMs extend duration ( Soldan et al. 2022 ; Huang et al. 2024 ; Wang et al. 2025a ) . We instead preserve evidence across stages.
blocks.zh: 临时降落 方法包括建议/预测(Gao等人)。 2017; Hendricks等编. 2017; Ghosh等2019; Zhang等2020a.),2D地图 (Zhang等. 2020年b),DETR本地化(Lei等. 2021; 穆恩等编. 2023a; Moon等 2023b.),联合检索/亮相 (刘等. 2022; Lin等 2023),并长视频地取地(Hou等. 2023b; Pan et al. 2023; Mu等2024; Yuan等2025). 电影停放和视频LLMs延长了时间(Soldan等人)。 2022; 黄等. 2024; Wang等2025a.). 相反,我们保存了各阶段的证据。

blocks.en: Long-video evidence selection. Sparse selection can erase source identity. Pretraining, missing-modality modeling, calibration, and diversity reranking improve reliability ( Alayrac et al. 2020 ; Bain et al. 2021 ; Neverova et al. 2016 ; Ma et al. 2022 ; Guo et al. 2017 ; Carbonell and Goldstein 1998 ) . Ego4D methods reason over localized windows ( Grauman et al. 2022 ; Hou et al. 2023a ) . EP-LVMQA exposes an auditable moment; MomentSeeker is only an external MedVidQA planner baseline.
blocks.zh: 长相证取取. Sparse 选择可以去除源身份 。 预训、缺失模式模型、校准和多样性的重新排序提高了可靠性(Alayrac等)。 2020; Bain等编. 2021; Neverova等2016; Ma等2022; Guo等2017; Carbonell和Goldstein 1998.). Ego4D方法在本地化窗口上的理由(Grauman等. 2022; 侯等. 2023a. (中文(简体) ). EP-LVMQA暴露出一个可审计的时刻;MomentSeeker只是外部的MedVidQA规划者基线.

blocks.en: 3 Task Formulation
blocks.zh: 3 任务制定

blocks.en: Given 𝒟 = { ( V i , q i , M i ∗ ) } i = 1 N \mathcal{D}=\{(V_{i},q_{i},M_{i}^{\ast})\}_{i=1}^{N} , where M i ∗ M_{i}^{\ast} contains annotated answer-supporting intervals, the model predicts M ^ = { ( s ^ k , e ^ k , c ^ k , r ^ k ) } k = 1 N b . \widehat{M}=\{(\hat{s}_{k},\hat{e}_{k},\hat{c}_{k},\hat{r}_{k})\}_{k=1}^{N_{b}}. (1) Here ( s ^ k , e ^ k ) (\hat{s}_{k},\hat{e}_{k}) is an evidence moment, c ^ k \hat{c}_{k} its confidence, and r ^ k \hat{r}_{k} an externally inspectable provenance record rather than a hidden reasoning chain. Although multiple intervals are permitted, we evaluate the top-ranked prediction against the best-overlapping annotation. At temporal unit t t , we retain y t = { v t , x t asr , x t ocr , x t cap , m t , c t } , y_{t}=\{v_{t},x_{t}^{\mathrm{asr}},x_{t}^{\mathrm{ocr}},x_{t}^{\mathrm{cap}},m_{t},c_{t}\}, (2) where m t m_{t} and c t c_{t} encode source availability and confidence. Generated captions are uncertain cues, not ground-truth subtitles.

The Evidence-Preserving Candidate Interface transfers a model-facing evidence card from the planner to the localizer. We distinguish this card from the returned evidence moment and its output-facing evidence trace . This distinction prevents the interface from being reduced to a post-hoc explanation.
blocks.zh: 证据-保留候选人界面将模型化的证据卡从规划者转移到本地化者. 我们把这张卡与 返回的证据瞬间 及其输出的证据追踪区分开来 这种区分使得接口无法被简化为后热解说.

blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: Figure 2 organizes EP-LVMQA into three modules. Question-Conditioned Evidence Cues condition the planner and localizer, which exchange an evidence card through the Evidence-Preserving Candidate Interface.
blocks.zh: 图2将EP-LVMQA组织为三个模块. 有问题 证据库斯对规划者和本地化者提出条件,后者通过证据-保留候选人界面交换证据卡.

blocks.en: Figure 2: EP-LVMQA comprises three modules: (a) an Uncertainty-Aware Multimodal Evidence Timeline, (b) a Coarse Evidence Planner, and (c) an Evidence-Conditioned Fine Localizer. Question-Conditioned Evidence Cues condition the planner and localizer, which communicate through an Evidence-Preserving Candidate Interface implemented as an evidence card.
blocks.zh: 图2:EP-LVMQA包含三个模块:(a) 不确定的、有意识的多式联运证据时间表;(b) 粗细的证据规划员;以及(c) 有证据的精细本地化器。 有问题 证据库斯将规划者和本地化者作为条件,后者通过作为证据卡执行的证据-保留候选人界面进行沟通.

blocks.zh: 4.1 不确定性-意识到的多式联运 证据时限

blocks.en: Native ASR/OCR confidence is clipped at the 1st and 99th training percentiles and min–max calibrated; G j m G_{j}^{m} is mean projected cosine agreement with available streams within ± 4 \pm 4 s. The planner uses the masked mean confidence, while the localizer learns question-dependent source weights. Separating these operations avoids using the localizer’s learned routing score as evidence for its own candidate selection.

blocks.en: 4.2 Coarse Evidence Planner
blocks.zh: 4.2 粗证据规划员

blocks.en: The planner compresses the search space while preserving candidate recall. Each window retains its span, source features, mask, and mean confidence.
blocks.zh: 计划者在保留候选人召回的同时压缩了搜索空间. 每个窗口都保留其跨度、源特性、口罩和平均信心。

blocks.en: To bridge indirect questions to observable actions, a fixed rule-assisted parser extracts action/verb-particle, object, temporal, and high-IDF domain cues, retaining at most four per type. A cue survives only if its maximum text/visual/caption similarity to memory exceeds θ c = 0.30 \theta_{c}=0.30 ; otherwise only the question embedding is used. The planner scores a window as S j = f θ ​ ( [ h q ; h j vis ; h j asr ; h j ocr ; h j cap ; ρ ¯ j ; m j ; ψ j ] ) , S_{j}=f_{\theta}([h_{q};h_{j}^{\rm vis};h_{j}^{\rm asr};h_{j}^{\rm ocr};h_{j}^{\rm cap};\bar{\rho}_{j};m_{j};\psi_{j}]), (4) where ψ j \psi_{j} encodes position, duration, and neighboring agreement. MMR selection ( λ MMR = 0.20 \lambda_{\rm MMR}=0.20 ) reduces redundancy; adjacent windows within 4 s are merged subject to a 96 s cap and a global duration budget.

blocks.en: The planner targets evidence recall rather than boundary accuracy. Its compact candidate union should cover the decisive moment; candidate duration and an oracle upper bound separate search from localization failure.
blocks.zh: 规划者的目标是证据召回而不是边界准确性。 其紧凑的候选工会应涵盖决定性的时刻;候选期限和甲骨文上方的搜索与本地化失败分开。

blocks.en: The interface instantiates each selected candidate j j as an evidence card p j = { τ j , S j , Ω j , ρ j , m j , ξ j , ν j , π j } , p_{j}=\{\tau_{j},S_{j},\Omega_{j},\rho_{j},m_{j},\xi_{j},\nu_{j},\pi_{j}\}, (5) containing its span, score, modality payload, confidence and mask, matched cues, neighboring context, and a Gaussian temporal prior. Training labels and human audit scores are excluded from model input.

The prior is centered on the highest-scoring constituent window, with standard deviation equal to half the window length. Immediate neighboring summaries help distinguish repeated steps without restoring the full video. Model-input fields are versioned separately from training-only IoU labels and audit-only judgments.
blocks.zh: 前置以得分最高的组成窗口为中心,标准偏差等于窗口长度的一半. 即时相邻摘要有助于区分重复步骤,而不恢复完整视频. 模式输入字段与只培训的IoU标签和只审计的判断分开版本.

blocks.en: 4.3 Evidence-Conditioned Fine Localizer
blocks.zh: 4.3 有证据条件 精细本地化器

A question-conditioned router assigns ω j m = m j m ​ exp ⁡ ( W r ​ [ h q ; h j m ; ρ j m ] ) ∑ m ′ m j m ′ ​ exp ⁡ ( W r ​ [ h q ; h j m ′ ; ρ j m ′ ] ) + ϵ , \omega_{j}^{m}=\frac{m_{j}^{m}\exp(W_{r}[h_{q};h_{j}^{m};\rho_{j}^{m}])}{\sum_{m^{\prime}}m_{j}^{m^{\prime}}\exp(W_{r}[h_{q};h_{j}^{m^{\prime}};\rho_{j}^{m^{\prime}}])+\epsilon}, (6) so unavailable sources receive zero weight. A transformer fuses routed tokens and residual cue attention. blocks.en: Training is sequential. Planner windows are positive at maximum IoU ≥ 0.3 \geq 0.3 , negative below 0.1, and otherwise ignored. Binary cross-entropy is combined with margin ranking (margin 0.2) against semantically similar non-overlapping negatives; the selected planner is then frozen and Top- K K candidates are cached.

blocks.en: 5.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 设置

blocks.en: Datasets and metrics. MedVidQA is the target benchmark; Ego4D-NLQ and QVHighlights test cross-domain grounding compatibility ( Gupta et al. 2023 ; Grauman et al. 2022 ; Lei et al. 2021 ) . We report rank-1 recall at temporal IoU thresholds, mIoU, planner recall, candidate duration, compression, and runtime. Baselines include VSLNet, Moment-DETR, QD/CG-DETR, UniVTG, CausalVTG, SRF, CONE, GroundNLQ, Grounded-VideoLLM, and TimeZero ( Zhang et al. 2020a ; Lei et al. 2021 ; Moon et al. 2023b ; Moon et al. 2023a ; Lin et al. 2023 ; Wang et al. 2025b ; Lee and Kim 2026 ; Hou et al. 2023b ; Hou et al. 2023a ; Wang et al. 2025a ; Wang et al. 2025c ) . Reproduced feature-based methods use matched preprocessing and budgets; Video-LLMs use matched prompts and evidence budgets. Official results are reference-only.
blocks.zh: 数据集与计量. 医疗维度 QA是目标基准;Ego4D-NLQ和QV高亮测试跨域地基相通性(Gupta等2023;Grauman等2022;Lei等2021.). 我们报告1级召回时间为IoU阈值、mIoU、规划员召回时间、候选期限、压缩时间和运行时间。 基线包括VSLNet、Moment-DETR、QD/CG-DETR、UniVTG、CausalVTG、SRF、CONE、GroundNLQ、地基-视频LM和TimeZero(Zhang等人,2020年a;Lei等人)。 2021; 穆恩等编. 2023b; Moon等编. 2023a; 林等. 2023; 王等编. 2025b; Lee and Kim 2026; Hou et al. 页:1 2023a; 王等2025a; 王等. 2025c. (中文(简体) ). 复制的基于特性的方法使用匹配的预处理和预算; Video-LLMs使用匹配的提示和证据预算. 官方结果仅供参考。

blocks.en: For localization, R1 ​ @ ​ τ \mathrm{R1}@\tau is the fraction of questions whose top-ranked interval overlaps any annotation by at least τ \tau . Planner recall requires at least one selected candidate at IoU ≥ 0.3 \geq 0.3 . Candidate duration is the duration of the union of selected candidates divided by video duration, and compression is its reciprocal. The long-duration split contains official MedVidQA test videos longer than 900 s and all associated QA pairs.
blocks.zh: 对于本地化,R1 @ \ mathrm{ R1}@\tau 是一个问题小分点, 其中排在上位的间隔至少与\ tau 的注释相重叠 。 规划员召回要求至少一名选入IOU的候选人 0.3\geq 0.3 (英语). 候选人持续时间是被选中候选人的结合时间,除以视频持续时间,压缩是互惠的. 长期分拆包含超过900 s的官方MedVidQA测试视频和所有相關QA對.

blocks.en: Human-audit design. We fixed 300 MedVidQA queries before inspecting system outputs. Input-only strata combine video-duration quartile, question-complexity bin, and source availability/quality; model scores and predictions never determine inclusion. Every method is evaluated on the same queries. Method identity and output order are concealed from three raters. The question and reference answer or decision target are shown, but the method, evidence trace, and ground-truth timestamps are hidden. The keep view contains the predicted moment with a 2-s playback margin on each side and visibly marks the original boundaries.
blocks.zh: 人地审计设计. 在检查系统产出前,我们确定了300个MedVidQA查询。 仅输入的平面结合了视频-持续时间的夸克,问题-复杂度的bin,和源的可用性/质量;模型分数和预测永远不能决定包容. 每种方法都根据同样的询问进行评估。 方法身份和输出顺序被隐藏在三个评分中. 问题和参考答案或决定目标被显示,但方法、证据追踪和地面真实时间戳被隐藏。 保存视图包含预想的时刻,每边有2-s回放比值,并明显地标出原始边界.

blocks.en: Sufficiency and Verifiability are the two primary human outcomes. For Sufficiency, 0 means absent or misleading answer support, 1 partial but incomplete support, and 2 evidence sufficient to answer the question. For Verifiability, 0 means no directly identifiable answer evidence, 1 relevant evidence with incomplete context or imprecise boundaries, and 2 directly inspectable evidence with appropriate temporal scope. Sufficiency therefore targets semantic completeness, whereas Verifiability targets temporal inspectability. A 30-item pilot fixes the rubric before formal scoring. blocks.en: Fairness protocol. “Matched” feature-based baselines share temporal preprocessing, comparable source views and budgets, and timestamp post-processing. “Matched-prompt” Video-LLMs receive the same frame-token budget and aligned ASR/OCR/caption view but no evidence card, planner candidates, source router, or audit metadata. Architectures retain their original encoders and fusion modules. Table 1 marks each row as reported/official (Off.), independently reproduced (Rep.), matched feature-based (M), matched-prompt (MP), or ours. Official rows are reference-only and are excluded from strict budget-matched superiority claims.

AdamW trains the planner/localizer for at most 30/50 epochs with learning rates 2 × 10 − 4 / 10 − 4 2{\times}10^{-4}/10^{-4} and validation early stopping.

blocks.en: SlowFast and CLIP yield 2816-D visual tokens projected to 512 dimensions. Whisper uses greedy word timestamps; OCR retains English detections above 0.50; the frozen captioner describes visible action, manipulated object, and procedural state in at most 32 new tokens. Candidates use at most 128 temporal tokens. Both stages use weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} , gradient clipping at 1.0, 5% warmup, and seeds { 0 , 1 , 2 } \{0,1,2\} .
blocks.zh: Slow Fast和CLIP产生2816-D可视符号,预计可达512个维. Whisper使用贪婪的单词时间戳;OCR保留了0.50以上的英语检测;被冻结的字幕描述可见的动作,被被操纵的对象,以及程序状态在最多32个新符中. 候选人最多使用128个时间标志. 两个阶段都使用重量衰变 10 - 4 10 - 4 - 4}, 梯度剪接以 1.0, 5%的热量, 和种子 { 0, 1, 2 } {0, 1, 2 } {0, 1, 2 }。

blocks.en: 5.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1: Main comparison with explicit result provenance. MedVidQA is the target setting; Ego4D-NLQ and QVHighlights are compatibility checks. Prot.: Off.=reported/official reference, Rep.=our reproduction, M=matched feature-based evaluation, MP=matched-prompt Video-LLM evaluation. Off./Rep. means that localization is official while audit values come from reproduced saved predictions; these values are not combined into a matched superiority claim. All audit columns are measured strict-majority rates on the common blinded 300-query set. Bold and underlining denote the best and second-best listed value per metric, irrespective of protocol class.
blocks.zh: 表1:与明确结果来源的主要比较。 医疗维度 QA是目标设定;Ego4D-NLQ和QV高光是相容性检查. Prot.:Off.=被报告/官方参考,Rep.=我们的复制,M=匹配的特征评价,MP=匹配-即时视频-LLM评价. Off./Rep.意味着本地化是官方的,而审计价值来自重复的已保存的预测;这些价值没有合并为相应的优越性主张。 所有审计栏均在普通的300克眼盲套上严格按多数计算。 粗体和下划线表示每公吨最佳和次最佳所列价值,而不论协议类别。

blocks.en: EP-LVMQA leads every MedVidQA metric in Table 1 . Relative to the strongest listed non-ours value, its gains are 13.2%, 31.8%, 34.9%, and 19.1% for R1 ​ @ ​ 0.3 \mathrm{R1}@0.3 , R1 ​ @ ​ 0.5 \mathrm{R1}@0.5 , R1 ​ @ ​ 0.7 \mathrm{R1}@0.7 , and mIoU, respectively. Beyond the target setting, EP-LVMQA shows reasonable cross-benchmark compatibility without benchmark-specific design, while performing only slightly below specialized methods, as shown in Figure 3 .
blocks.zh: EP-LVMQA领导表1中的每个MedVidQA度量. 相对于列出的最强非我们值,其收益分别为13.2%,31.8%,34.9%和19.1%的R1@0.3\mathrm{R1}@0.3,R1@0.5\mathrm{R1}@0.5,R1@0.7\mathrm{R1}@0.7,和mIoU. 在设定目标之外,EP-LVMQA显示合理的跨基准相容性,没有特定基准的设计,而只表现略低于专门方法,如图3所显示.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Cross-benchmark performance on (a) Ego4D-NLQ and (b) QVHighlights, showing the top three methods for each metric. Ours denotes EP-LVMQA.
blocks.zh: 图3:在(a) Ego4D-NLQ和(b) QV亮点上的跨基准性能,显示每个公尺的前三种方法. 我们表示EP -LVMQA。

blocks.en: Finding 1: EP-LVMQA exhibits larger gains at stricter IoU thresholds. Against matched UniVTG, the relative gain rises from 20.1% at R1 ​ @ ​ 0.3 \mathrm{R1}@0.3 to 31.8% at R1 ​ @ ​ 0.5 \mathrm{R1}@0.5 and 41.6% at R1 ​ @ ​ 0.7 \mathrm{R1}@0.7 . The widening margin at stricter IoU thresholds indicates that EP-LVMQA’s gains arise not only from coarse retrieval but also from more precise boundary localization enabled by the Evidence-Preserving Candidate Interface, allowing it to better isolate answer-bearing actions from adjacent procedural steps.
blocks.zh: 调查结果1:EP-LVMQA在更严格的IoU阈值上显示出更大的收益. 相对于匹配的UniVTG,相对增益从R1的20.1%@0.3\mathrm{R1}@0.3到31.8%在R1@0.5\mathrm{R1}@0.5到41.6%在R1@0.7\mathrm{R1}@0.7. 在更严格的IoU阈值下,幅度的扩大表明EP-LVMQA的收益不仅出自粗糙的检索,也出自证据-保留候选界面所允许的更精确的边界定位,从而能够更好地将有答案的行动与相邻的程序步骤相分离。

blocks.en: Finding 2: Human-audit metrics capture practical utility beyond conventional localization scores. EP-LVMQA improves the strongest listed non-ours Suff.@2 and Ver.@2 values by 59.7% and 63.8%, exceeding its relative gains on IoU-based metrics. The strongest localization and audit baselines are also different models. Sufficiency tests whether the returned content answers the question, whereas Verifiability additionally requires identifiable and well-scoped evidence. A prediction can overlap the annotation yet remain too broad, incomplete, or ambiguous for either criterion. Temporal overlap is therefore related to, but not equivalent to, practical answer support. Nevertheless, the absolute rates remain low—only 25.4% and 22.6%, respectively—and are still insufficient to support reliable use in real-world human-facing settings.
blocks.zh: 调查结果2:人力-审计衡量标准掌握了超出常规本地化分数的实际效用。 EP-LVMQA将列出的最强非我们的Suff.@2和Ver.@2的值提高了59.7%和63.8%,超过了其在基于IoU的度量衡上的相对收益. 最强的地方化和审计基线也是不同的模型. 充分性检验返回的内容是否回答了问题,而可核实性还需要可识别和范围明确的证据。 预测可能与注释相重叠,但对于任何一项标准来说仍然过于宽泛、不完整或模棱两可。 因此,时间重叠与实际答案支持有关,但不等同于实际答案支持。 然而,绝对比率仍然很低,分别为25.4%和22.6%,仍然不足以支持在现实世界中可靠地使用人文资源。

blocks.en: 5.3 Robustness and Planner Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.3 稳健性和计划分析

blocks.en: Table 2: MedVidQA robustness in R1@0.5. ASR/OCR-50 removes half the corresponding evidence; HN-Cap uses semantically similar non-overlapping caption negatives; Conflict retains ASR but replaces captions. Avg. drop is the mean relative loss across the four perturbations. All methods receive the same degraded input views.
blocks.zh: 表2:MedVidQA坚固度为R1@0.5. ASR/OCR-50移除了一半的相应证据;HN-Cap使用类似非相重叠的字幕底片;冲突保留了ASR但替换了字幕. 下降是四起扰动中的平均相对损失。 所有方法都得到相同的退化输入视图。

blocks.en: EP-LVMQA has the highest score under every perturbation and the lowest mean relative drop, 11.1%, compared with the strongest non-ours value of 14.6% achieved by CausalVTG (Table 2 ). This is a 3.5-point absolute and 24.0% relative reduction in average degradation.
blocks.zh: EP-LVMQA在每次扰动下得分最高,而平均相对下降率最低,为11.1%,而CausalVTG实现的最强非我们值为14.6%(表2)。 这是3.5分的绝对值,相对平均退化减少24.0%。

blocks.en: Finding 3: EP-LVMQA’s advantage widens under semantic distraction and cross-modal conflict. Relative to the strongest non-ours method in each column, EP-LVMQA gains 41.9% under ASR-50 over UniVTG and 35.5% under OCR-50 over SRF. Under incorrect-evidence perturbations, it outperforms CausalVTG by 41.1% under HN-Cap and 42.9% under Conflict. These margins all exceed its 31.8% gain over UniVTG on clean input. Under Conflict, Suff.@2 also increases from 11.9 to 20.8, an 8.9-point gain.
blocks.zh: 结果3:EP-LVMQA的优势在语义分心和跨模式冲突下扩大. 相对于各栏中最强的非我们方法,EP-LVMQA在ASR-50下比UniVTG增收41.9%,在OCR-50下比SRF增收35.5%。 在不正确证据扰动下,HN-Cap的CausalVTG表现超过41.1%,冲突为42.9%。 这些边际都超过了清洁输入UnivTG的31.8%。 在冲突下,Suff.@2也从11.9增加到20.8,收获了8.9分.

blocks.en: Across all methods, incorrect-evidence perturbations cause a 24.9% relative drop, nearly twice the 12.8% drop under missing-source perturbations. Remaining modalities can partly compensate for a missing source, whereas plausible but incorrect evidence can redirect localization toward an incorrect moment. Robust localization therefore requires rejecting unreliable evidence, not merely retrieving more evidence.
blocks.zh: 在所有方法中,不正确证据扰动造成24.9%的相对下降,几乎是缺失源扰动下12.8%的两倍。 其余模式可以部分地弥补缺失来源,而可信但不正确的证据可以将本地化转向不正确的时刻。 因此,强有力的本地化需要拒绝不可靠的证据,而不仅仅是取回更多的证据。

blocks.en: Table 3: Planner and candidate-budget analysis on MedVidQA videos over 15 min. Block A fixes Top-5; Block B varies K K . Cand. R@0.3 is candidate recall; Sel. dur. is candidate-union/video duration. Cached time excludes offline extraction. † Oracle changes selection only; the fixed localizer receives no ground-truth boundaries.
blocks.zh: 表3:对15分以上MedVidQA视频的规划和候选人预算分析。 A区修正了Top-5;B区更改了K K. Cand.R@0.3为候选人召回;Sel.dur.为候选人-工会/视频持续时间. 延迟时间不包括离线提取。 Oracle只更改选择;固定本地化器没有获得地面真实边界。

blocks.en: Table 3 separates planner quality from candidate budget. Under the common Top-5 setting, EP-LVMQA achieved 80.6 candidate recall and 23.8 final R1 ​ @ ​ 0.5 \mathrm{R1}@0.5 . Relative to the same planner without confidence inputs, these scores increased by 12.2 and 2.9 points at nearly unchanged selected duration (10.8% versus 10.9%) and cached time (0.54 versus 0.53 s/query). EP-LVMQA also exceeded the MomentSeeker Top-5 baseline by 18.7 candidate-recall points and 5.6 final localization points while selecting less video. The improvement therefore reflects better candidate selection rather than a larger evidence budget.
blocks.zh: 表3将规划人员的质量与候选人预算分开。 在共同的Top-5设置下,EP-LVMQA实现了80.6名候选人召回,23.8名最终R1@0.5\mathrm{R1}@0.5. 相对于没有信心投入的同一规划人员,这些分数在几乎没有变化的选定时间(10.8%对10.9%)和缓存时间(0.54对0.53 s/query)上增加了12.2分和2.9分. EP-LVMQA还比MomentSeeker Top-5基线多了18.7个候选召回点和5.6个最终本地化点,同时选择了较少的视频. 因此,这一改善反映出候选人的甄选情况更好,而不是更大的证据预算。

blocks.en: The budget sweep identifies Top-5 as the operating-point knee. Increasing K K from 3 to 5 added 9.5 candidate-recall points and 2.4 final R1 ​ @ ​ 0.5 \mathrm{R1}@0.5 points for 4.3 additional duration points. Increasing K K from 5 to 10 added a similar 8.3 recall points but only 0.9 final points, while selected duration rose from 10.8% to 20.2% and cached time from 0.54 to 0.83 s/query. Top-10 nevertheless remained 6.5 points below oracle selection, showing that increased candidate coverage alone cannot eliminate errors in candidate ranking and boundary refinement.
blocks.zh: 预算扫射确定TOP-5为手术点膝盖. KK从3个增加到5个,增加了9.5个候选点-召回点和2.4个最后R1 @ 0.5\mathrm{R1}@0.5分,额外延长点4.3个. KK从5个增加到10个,增加了相类似的8.3个召回分数,但只有0.9个最后分数,而选定的持续时间从10.8%增加到20.2%,缓存时间从0.54到0.83 s/平分. 然而,前10名仍低于甲骨文甄选6.5分,表明仅增加候选人覆盖面无法消除候选人排名和完善边界方面的错误。

blocks.en: 5.4 Ablation and Human-Audited Evidence
blocks.zh: 5.4 证据和经人审计的证据

blocks.en: Table 4: Stage-level references and component ablations on MedVidQA. Checks/crosses mark enabled/removed components or downstream unavailability. TL is the evidence timeline; Src contains modality evidence, masks, and confidence; Rtr is the source router; Conflict is R1@0.5 under ASR–caption conflict. Suff.@2 and Ver.@2 are primary outcomes; Nec.@2 is auxiliary. Audit values use the common blinded set and strict-majority rule; all variants share the split, encoders, Top-5 budget, backbone, optimizer, and evaluation.
blocks.zh: 表4:关于MedVidQA的阶段性参考和组成部分。 检查/交叉标记启用/删除组件或下游无法使用。 TL 是证据时间表; Src 包含模式证据、口罩和信心; Rtr 是源路由器; 冲突是 ASR - caption 冲突下的 R1@0.5. suff.@2和Ver.@2是主要结果;Nec.@2是辅助结果. 审计值采用常见的被蒙蔽的套装和严格多数规则;所有变种都分享分出,编码器,Top-5预算,骨干,优化器,以及评价.

blocks.en: The card-mediated intervention affects the two primary audit outcomes more strongly than conventional overlap (Table 4 ). Removing it reduces R1 ​ @ ​ 0.5 \mathrm{R1}@0.5 by 4.4 points, but reduces Suff.@2 and Ver.@2 by 8.5 and 8.3 points. Across the seven removals, the mean audit decline is roughly twice the corresponding R1 ​ @ ​ 0.5 \mathrm{R1}@0.5 decline. Because removing the card also removes its dependent fields, this row estimates the whole planner-to-localizer evidence contract rather than the serialized container alone.
blocks.zh: 以卡为媒介的干预对两项主要审计结果的影响比常规重叠更为强烈(表4)。 删除后, R1@ 0. 5\ mathrm{ R1\ 0. 5乘以 4. 4 分, 但将 Suff. @ 2 和 Ver.@ 2 乘以 8. 5和 8. 3分 。 在7个清除量中,平均审计下降大约是相应R1的两倍@ 0.5\mathrm{R1}@0.5。 由于去除卡片也会去除其所依赖的字段,这行估计的是整个规划师对本地化的证据合同,而不是单是系列化的容器.

blocks.en: The stage-level references further separate evidence capture from temporal precision. Relative to standard moment retrieval, the coarse planner raises Suff.@2 from 14.8 to 17.6 but lowers R1 ​ @ ​ 0.7 \mathrm{R1}@0.7 from 10.1 to 8.7. A coarse window can therefore contain answer-bearing evidence while remaining a poor temporal explanation. Fine localization is needed to convert semantic coverage into a sharply scoped moment.
blocks.zh: 阶段级参考进一步将证据捕捉与时间精度区分开来. 相对于标准瞬间检索,粗细的平面规划器将Suff.@2从14.8提高到17.6,但将R1从0.7\mathrm{R1}@0.7从10.1降到8.7. 因此,粗糙的窗口可以包含有答案的证据,而时间上的解释仍然很差。 精细的本地化需要将语义覆盖转换成一个剧烈的可扩展瞬间.

blocks.en: Source identity accounts for much of the conflict result. Removing source fields lowers conflict R1 ​ @ ​ 0.5 \mathrm{R1}@0.5 by 4.6 points and Suff.@2 by 6.6 points. Removing the prior has a larger effect at R1 ​ @ ​ 0.7 \mathrm{R1}@0.7 than at R1 ​ @ ​ 0.5 \mathrm{R1}@0.5 (1.6 versus 1.1 points), which is consistent with boundary sharpening. Cues and context produce smaller gains across all criteria. These effects are not additive: removing the timeline also disables downstream source fields and routing, so the − - TL row measures the whole source-preservation pathway rather than the marginal value of timeline construction.
blocks.zh: 冲突的结果大多是来源身份。 删除源字段会降低冲突 R1 @ 0. 5\ mathrm{ R1} 0. 5 乘 4.6 分和 Suff. @ 2 乘 6. 分. 删除前一个值在R1 @ 0. 7\ mathrm{R1}@0. 7 时的效果大于R1 @ 0.5\ mathrm{R1}@0. 5 (1.6相比 1.1分), 这与边界磨合一致. 在各种标准中,因地制宜的收益较小。 这些效果不是添加剂:去除时间线也会使下游源字段和路由失效,因此---TL行会测量整个源保护路径,而不是时间线构造的边际值.

blocks.en: The ablations also form a consistent functional hierarchy. Removing the card produces the largest joint loss in localization and both primary audit outcomes. Removing source fields or the confidence/router pair most strongly affects conflict robustness, whereas the prior has a disproportionate effect at the stricter IoU threshold. Cue and context removal causes smaller but aligned declines. This ordering links the interface to evidence transfer, source-aware fields to reliability control, and the prior to boundary precision. Because several interventions disable dependent fields, the table supports pathway-level attribution rather than additive component effects.
blocks.zh: 活化还形成一致的功能分级. 删除卡片会产生本地化和主要审计结果中最大的联合损失。 删除源字段或置信/路由对最强烈地影响冲突稳健性,而前置则对更严格的IoU阈值产生不成比例的影响. 取消Cue和上下文会导致较小但一致的下降。 此命令将接口连接到证据传输,源意识字段与可靠性控制,以及边界精度之前. 由于若干干预措施使依赖字段失去功能,该表支持路径级归属,而不是添加剂成分效应。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: EP-LVMQA couples an uncertainty-aware multimodal timeline, a coarse planner, and a source-routed fine localizer through a compact evidence card. On MedVidQA, it improves temporal localization, perturbation robustness, and audited evidence quality while remaining competitive on external benchmarks. Figure 4 illustrates tighter or more resilient selections under complete, missing, and conflicting evidence. Nevertheless, absolute audit rates remain too low for dependable human-facing deployment.
blocks.zh: EP-LVMQA夫妇通过紧凑的证据卡,获得一种意识到不确定性的多模式时间表,一种粗糙的规划师,以及一种源路精细的本地化器. 在MedVidQA方面,它提高了时间定位、扰动强度和审计证据质量,同时在外部基准上保持竞争力。 图4显示,在完整、缺失和相互冲突的证据下,选择更为严格或更具弹性。 然而,绝对审计率仍然过低,难以进行可靠的人力部署。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Frame-level comparisons under complete, missing, and conflicting evidence. EP-LVMQA is tighter or more resilient than TimeZero, retaining target overlap with incomplete or inconsistent evidence.
blocks.zh: 图4:框架层面在完整、缺失和相冲突证据下的比较。 EP-LVMQA比TimeZero更紧或更具有弹性,保留目标重叠与不完整或不一致的证据.
